text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, to celebrate this holy night...
Um... would you like to go with me to see the...
uh, the light of dawn spun by the people?

"Looks like Vodka was influenced by something again.
Holy night... lights... people... going to see...
Today is Christmas. Speaking of lights—"
choice_data_list: Are you going to see the illuminations?
Are you going to see the illuminations?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you totally get it! It feels so good
when you nail it with some cool phrasing~!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Truly the supreme...—wait, that's not it! Anyway, tonight! You promised, got it?!

That night, as promised,
I headed into town with Vodka, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"A night of blessings offered by the gods...
Now then, shall we begin...
our rendezvous with a miracle!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...And then next, she definitely said 'Drown in the luminous night'...
so like this!"

Muttering something to herself,
she dashed off toward the illumination display.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How's that?!
Doesn't it look like I'm drowning in the light?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on a second!
I'll be right back, so don't you dare move from here, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gim-senpai! I drowned in the nocturnal glow, but everyone's reaction wasn't really what I expected...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Do not worry.
Soon, this chaos shall engulf you all as well.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Surrender yourselves...! Let your souls burn...!
All you need to do is run through the chaos.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If I just run...!
I see, thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting! Listen up!
Tonight, everyone's gonna run with a fire in their souls!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, in short, it means just run!
Now that that's settled, let's get going right away!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Uwoooooh~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Looking good! Just be careful
not to bump into the people around you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hurry, hurry!
Let's move at a speed that's practically running!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Phew, made a full loop around the street!
Now then...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...So, what should we do?
choice_data_list: What did Tanino Gimlet say to you?
What did Tanino Gimlet say to you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh, how did you know that...?
Wait, did you notice!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay! Whyyyy...!
I was sure I hid it perfectly, toooo!!
Afterward, once I soothed Vodka and she calmed down, I asked her about the whole story—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Geez, everyone's getting so carried away...
Christmas is only exciting for little kids, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I'm gonna play it cool!
... ......H-Hmph."

...What shapes the night is not the darkness,
but the radiance of the stars, and the echoes played by life.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gim-senpai...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"The holy night is the supreme night of all nights...!!
It is also a night to show gratitude for the preciousness of life."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"With light and sound... and with my very own body,
I'll paint the night and pay homage to all creation."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gratitude... respect...!?
That's kinda... so c-cool!?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: If thou wouldst know more, partake in the joy and feel it for thyself. There is no teacher quite like experience.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Understood!
I'm gonna go enjoy Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Exhilaration is proportional to the number of souls—
why not share in this supreme moment together?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Ah!
You mean I should go with someone, right!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And that's why! Gim-senpai is just so darn cool after all~.

It seems Tanino Gimlet wants Vodka to enjoy Christmas.
If so, the right words to say are—
choice_data_list: Let's enjoy Christmas just the way you want to!
Let's enjoy Christmas just the way you want!
If we're doing this, let's all have fun together.

text_block_list.text:
It seems Tanino Gimlet wants Vodka to enjoy Christmas.
If so, the right words to say are—
choice_data_list: Let's enjoy Christmas just the way you want to!
Let's enjoy Christmas just the way you want!
If we're doing this, let's all have fun together.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Me...? I see.
Yeah, relying on you for everything really ain't cool."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
In that case, there's something I want to try!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... I've been wanting to
climb this tower for a while now!
choice_data_list: *pant* *pant*... Did we really... have to take the stairs...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Come on, why not? Once in a while!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ......Heh, so this is the path you have chosen to walk.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Everyone... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So with that, Senpai, let's enjoy
Christmas together!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... So that's how you play it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yet, it is precisely because it was unpredictable
that my heart races and my soul rejoices.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Very well.
Shall we enjoy this holy night together?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I've been wanting to come here
for a while now too!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This is the place closest to the night.
For now, let us melt in silence into this holy, quiet night—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: S-So awesome...!!

And so, Vodka's admiration for
Tanino Gimlet only grew stronger.
